title: karni suggest --json
description: Experimental. The output of karni suggest --json.

code.description: The code, SUG001 to SUG007 (karni explain <code>).

rule.description: The rule id a `# karni: allow(<rule>): <reason>` marker names to silence it.

file.description: The file, relative to the project root.

line.description: The 1-based line, null when the whole file.

message.description: What the project does by hand.

command.description: The command to run when the fix is one (karni remove charts), else null.

enabled.description: false when the project turned suggestions off (KARNI_SUGGESTIONS = False).

suggestions.description: The suggestions, by code, then file and line. They never fail a run.
